Y.USE_FLAG, -- [27] Y.GUBUN_FLAG, -- [28] Y.ES_STATUS, -- [29] Y.SAFETY_OPEN_FLAG, -- [30] Y.ES_FI_STATUS -- [31] FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM NUM, X.USE_TEXT, X.BUYER_ITEM_NO, X.MM_DATE, X.EE_DATE, SELECT CASE WHEN A.USE_FLAG = 'S' AND A.RECV_FLAG NOT IN ('ED','FY') THEN '1' ELSE CASE WHEN A.USE_FLAG = 'N' AND A.RECV_FLAG NOT IN ('ED','FY') THEN '2' ELSE CASE WHEN A.USE_FLAG = 'S' AND A.RECV_FLAG IN ('ED','FY') THEN '3' ELSE CASE WHEN A.USE_FLAG = 'N' AND A.RECV_FLAG IN ('ED','FY') THEN '4' END END END END AS SO_FLAG, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, NVL(A.MM_DATE,TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD')) AS MM_DATE, NVL(A.EE_DATE,TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD')) AS EE_DATE, A.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, A.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, A.MAKER_NAME AS MAKER_NAME, DECODE(A.USE_FLAG,'S','긴급','N','일반','') AS USE_TEXT, DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'ED','icon_y.gif', 'FY','icon_g.gif', 'GB','icon_b.gif', DECODE(NVL(A.MM_STATUS,'N'),'N','icon_w.gif','ED','icon_r.gif')) AS MM_STATUS, DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'ED','icon_y.gif', 'FY','icon_g.gif', 'GB','icon_b.gif', DECODE(NVL(A.DD_STATUS,'N'),'RC','icon_r.gif','ED','icon_r.gif','icon_w.gif')) AS DD_RECV_STATUS, DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'ED','icon_y.gif', 'FY','icon_g.gif', 'GB','icon_b.gif', DECODE(NVL(A.DD_STATUS,'N'),'ED','icon_r.gif','icon_w.gif')) AS DD_ED_STATUS, DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'ED','icon_y.gif', 'FY','icon_g.gif', 'GB','icon_b.gif', DECODE(NVL(A.EE_STATUS,'N'),'RC','icon_r.gif','ED','icon_r.gif','icon_w.gif')) AS EE_RECV_STATUS, DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'ED','icon_y.gif', 'FY','icon_g.gif', 'GB','icon_b.gif', DECODE(NVL(A.EE_STATUS,'N'),'ED','icon_r.gif','icon_w.gif')) AS EE_ED_STATUS, DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'ED','icon_y.gif', 'FY','icon_g.gif', 'GB','icon_b.gif', DECODE(NVL(A.ES_MK1_STATUS,'N'),'N','icon_w.gif','B','icon_b.gif','Y','icon_r.gif','icon_w.gif')) AS ES_MK_STATUS, DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'ED','icon_y.gif', 'FY','icon_g.gif', 'GB','icon_b.gif', DECODE(NVL(A.ES_PD1_STATUS,'N'),'N','icon_w.gif','B','icon_b.gif','Y','icon_r.gif','icon_w.gif')) AS ES_PD_STATUS, DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'ED','icon_y.gif', 'FY','icon_g.gif', 'GB','icon_b.gif', DECODE(NVL(A.ES_QA1_STATUS,'N'),'N','icon_w.gif','B','icon_b.gif','Y','icon_r.gif','icon_w.gif')) AS ES_QA_STATUS, DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'ED','icon_y.gif', 'FY','icon_g.gif', 'GB','icon_b.gif', DECODE(NVL(A.ES_FI_STATUS,'N'),'N','icon_w.gif','B','icon_b.gif','Y','icon_r.gif','icon_w.gif')) AS ES_FI_STATUS, DECODE(A.USE_FLAG,'S','긴급','N','일반','') AS USE_TEXT, DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'ED','종료', 'FY','/resources/images/icon_g.gif', 'GB','반려', DECODE(NVL(A.MM_STATUS,'N'),'N','미처리','ED','처리')) AS MM_STATUS, DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'ED','종료', 'FY','/resources/images/icon_g.gif', 'GB','반려', DECODE(NVL(A.DD_STATUS,'N'),'RC','처리','ED','처리','미처리')) AS DD_RECV_STATUS, DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'ED','종료', 'FY','/resources/images/icon_g.gif', 'GB','반려', DECODE(NVL(A.DD_STATUS,'N'),'ED','처리','미처리')) AS DD_ED_STATUS, DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'ED','종료', 'FY','/resources/images/icon_g.gif', 'GB','반려', DECODE(NVL(A.EE_STATUS,'N'),'RC','처리','ED','처리','미처리')) AS EE_RECV_STATUS, DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'ED','종료', 'FY','/resources/images/icon_g.gif', 'GB','반려', DECODE(NVL(A.EE_STATUS,'N'),'ED','처리','미처리')) AS EE_ED_STATUS, DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'ED','종료', 'FY','/resources/images/icon_g.gif', 'GB','반려', DECODE(NVL(A.ES_MK1_STATUS,'N'),'N','미처리','B','반려','Y','처리','미처리')) AS ES_MK_STATUS, DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'ED','종료', 'FY','/resources/images/icon_g.gif', 'GB','반려', DECODE(NVL(A.ES_PD1_STATUS,'N'),'N','미처리','B','반려','Y','처리','미처리')) AS ES_PD_STATUS, DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'ED','종료', 'FY','/resources/images/icon_g.gif', 'GB','반려', DECODE(NVL(A.ES_QA1_STATUS,'N'),'N','미처리','B','반려','Y','처리','미처리')) AS ES_QA_STATUS, DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'ED','종료', 'FY','/resources/images/icon_g.gif', 'GB','반려', DECODE(NVL(A.ES_FI_STATUS,'N'),'N','미처리','B','반려','Y','처리','미처리')) AS ES_FI_STATUS, DECODE(A.GUBUN_FLAG,'NW','신규','OD','기존','ERR') AS GUBUN, NVL(A.RD_DATE,TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD')) AS RD_DATE, NVL(A.DD_DATE,TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD')) AS DD_DATE, NVL(A.ES_DATE,TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD')) AS ES_DATE, A.PLANT AS PLANT, A.BYCA_COMORG_CODE AS BYCA_COMORG_CODE, A.BUYER AS BUYER, A.OPKG_SEQ AS OPKG_SEQ, A.CONTRACT_NO AS CONTRACT_NO, A.CONTRACT_SEQ AS CONTRACT_SEQ, A.RECV_FLAG AS RECV_FLAG, A.USE_FLAG AS USE_FLAG, A.GUBUN_FLAG AS GUBUN_FLAG, DECODE(NVL(A.ES_MK1_STATUS,'N'),'Y', DECODE(NVL(A.ES_PD1_STATUS,'N'),'Y', DECODE(NVL(A.ES_QA1_STATUS,'N'),'Y','ED','RC'),'RC'),'RC') AS ES_STATUS, NVL(A.SAFETY_OPEN_FLAG,'N') AS SAFETY_OPEN_FLAG FROM DONGOPKG A WHERE A.STATUS <> 'D' AND A.BYCA_COMORG_CODE IN ('KRDONGG004') AND A.RECV_FLAG NOT IN ('FY') AND A.RD_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date} --시작일 AND A.MM_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date} --신제품확인완료일 AND A.DD_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date} --협력사선정완료일 AND A.EE_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date} --디자인완료일 AND A.ES_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date} --최종확정일 AND NVL(A.RECV_FLAG,'IG') = #{st_recv_flag} AND A.DD_STATUS = #{st_dd_status} -- 문안 AND A.EE_STATUS = #{st_ee_status} -- 디자인 AND DECODE(NVL(A.ES_MK_STATUS,'N'),'Y', DECODE(NVL(A.ES_PD_STATUS,'N'),'Y', DECODE(NVL(A.ES_QA_STATUS,'N'),'Y','ED','RC'),'RC'),'RC') = #{st_es_status} AND A.PRODUCT_FLAG = #{st_product_flag} AND (A.DESCRIPTION LIKE '%' || #{st_desc_spec} || '%' OR A.SPECIFICATION LIKE '%' || #{st_desc_spec} || '%' OR A.DESCRIPTION LIKE UPPER( '%' || #{st_desc_spec} || '%') OR A.SPECIFICATION LIKE UPPER( '%' || #{st_desc_spec} || '%') OR A.DESCRIPTION LIKE LOWER( '%' || #{st_desc_spec} || '%') OR A.SPECIFICATION LIKE LOWER( '%' || #{st_desc_spec} || '%') ) AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE '%' || #{st_buyer_item_no} || '%' AND A.BUYER = #{st_buyer} ORDER BY SO_FLAG, A.USE_FLAG DESC, A.RD_DATE DESC --시작일 ORDER BY SO_FLAG, A.USE_FLAG DESC, A.MM_DATE DESC --마케팅완료일 ORDER BY SO_FLAG, A.USE_FLAG DESC, A.DD_DATE DESC --문안완료일 ORDER BY SO_FLAG, A.USE_FLAG DESC, A.EE_DATE DESC --디자인완료일 ORDER BY SO_FLAG, A.USE_FLAG DESC, A.ES_DATE DESC --최종확정일 ) X ) Y

SELECT /*getBuyerMpDsCropProtectCheck*/ COUNT(*) AS DUP_CNT FROM ICOMCART WHERE BUYER = #{st_com_code} AND USER_ID = #{st_user_id} AND USE_FLAG = 'C' AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = #{st_buyer_item_no} AND AGENT = #{st_agent} AND CONTRACT_NO = #{st_contract_no} AND CONTRACT_SEQ = #{st_contract_seq} AND BYIT_COMORG_CODE = #{st_byit_comorg_code}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO ICOMCART ( /*insertBuyerMpDsCropProtectCreate*/ BUYER , USER_ID , BUYER_ITEM_NO , SEQ , CART_QTY , REG_DATE , USE_FLAG , AGENT , CONTRACT_NO , CONTRACT_SEQ , BYIT_COMORG_CODE , REMARK ) VALUES ( #{st_com_code} , #{st_user_id} , #{st_buyer_item_no} , (SELECT DECODE(MAX(SEQ),NULL,'0', MAX(SEQ))+1 FROM ICOMCART WHERE BUYER = #{st_com_code} AND USER_ID = #{st_user_id} AND USE_FLAG = 'C' ) , NVL(#{st_item_qty}, 1) , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , 'C' , #{st_agent} , #{st_contract_no} , #{st_contract_seq} , #{st_byit_comorg_code} , CASE WHEN #{st_com_code} = 'KRKOLO0016' OR #{st_buyer} = 'KRKEPB0004' THEN #{st_btoa_remark} ELSE '' END )
